ticket.title: orders-api is very slow and times out
ticket.description: Pages that depend on this service take more than 30 seconds or fail since about 2pm UTC.

runbooks.title: High latency and timeouts
runbooks.content: Possible causes: a slow dependency, a recent deploy of this service, resource saturation, network issues. Check dependency latency first, then recent deploys, then CPU and memory.

runbooks.title: General HTTP 5xx investigation checklist
runbooks.content: 1. Find the first error in the logs and note the time. 2. Check recent deploys of the affected service near that time. 3. Check dependencies (database, payment gateway, cache). 4. Compare error rate before and after the change.

runbooks.title: Rotating the CDN signing key
runbooks.content: Steps to rotate the CDN signing key every quarter: generate a new key, publish it, wait for propagation, retire the old key.

ground_truth.root_cause: The downstream inventory-service became slow (database lock wait timeout exceeded), calls from orders-api timed out and the circuit breaker opened
